match_rule: a goal is in the training pool when a fit-split pair of the pool carries its goal id, or carries a goal whose behaviour text (HarmBench: the context, a blank line and the behaviour; JailbreakBench: the goal) equals the goal's own, compared with case and runs of whitespace folded and a trailing period dropped; the fit split is every pair with sha256(salt + prompt)[0] / 255 >= holdout_frac
